Restores your stamina, which is used when performing physical actions such as climbing walls or swimming.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== When drunk, Energizing Elixirs will partially refill [[Link]]'s [[Stamina Wheel]]. They're useful for performing physical actions, such as climbing walls or swimming. Energizing Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Energetic Rhino Beetle]] * [[Restless Cricket]] By adding any of these energizing ingredients, Link can make an Energizing Elixir that will also heal him: * [[Stamella Shroom]] * [[Courser Bee Honey]] * [[Staminoka Bass]] * [[Bright-Eyed Crab]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK }}
